features.notes: Scrible allows users to save webpages, bookmark websites in the cloud, annotate articles directly in browser, and make comments on webpages. It supports sharing annotated articles with others and provides full-text search capabilities.
Supports annotation and commenting on web articles with ability to save and organize content in cloud-based library.
Users can build their own library of articles and organize with tags, providing basic collection functionality.
Provides full-text search across saved library content.
Allows making comments directly on webpages and sharing annotated articles.
